name: paper-companion-share
description: An academic paper reading companion that researches background, translates paragraph-by-paragraph into fluent Chinese, extracts highlights and critique notes, builds multi-paper study portals with bilingual side-by-side views and embedded PDFs, merges all notes into a single-file HTML digest, and maintains layered workspace-scoped memory without polluting the workspace.

displayName.zh: 论文研读助手 · 分享版

displayDescription.en: Intent-driven discovery with multi-source validation; paragraph-by-paragraph Chinese translation with critique notes; multi-paper study portals. No hallucination.
displayDescription.zh: 按意图检索论文（多源校验），精读逐段中文转写与批判注记，多篇汇成可视化研读门户，绝不幻觉。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我研读这篇论文（PDF/链接/标题），走默认全流程：背景调研→总体掌握→逐段流畅中文转写与总结→抓亮点与批判注记。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me study this paper (PDF/link/title). Follow the default flow: background research → overview → paragraph-by-paragraph fluent Chinese translation & summary → highlight and critique notes.

quickPrompts.en: Study this paper (PDF/link/title) via the full default flow
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我研读这篇论文（PDF/链接/标题），走默认全流程：背景调研→总体掌握→逐段流畅中文转写与总结→抓亮点与批判注记。

quickPrompts.en: Find papers in a research area (I'll tell you the topic)
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我检索某个方向的论文（我会告诉你主题），按我的意图选策略并做多源校验

quickPrompts.en: Build a multi-paper study portal (per-paper deep-dive pages + bilingual side-by-side + embedded PDFs)
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这几篇论文做成研读门户：每篇一个深度解析页（八模块）+ 中英双语对照 + 原文 PDF 内嵌，并配总门户导航
